mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `employee_contract` (contract_uuid, employee_uuid, contract_no, sign_type, contract_term_type, start_date, end_date, salary, probation_months, probation_salary, company_name, social_security_no, housing_fund_no, contract_status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{contractUuid}, #{employeeUuid}, #{contractNo}, #{signType}, #{contractTermType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{salary}, #{probationMonths}, #{probationSalary}, #{companyName}, #{socialSecurityNo}, #{housingFundNo}, #{contractStatus}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW())
